name: FUN_INTERCO_SOURCE_DOC_GROUPS
description: This table contains information of the source document groups corresponding to the master documents.

columns.description: Unique identifier for the source document group.

columns.description: Unique identifier for the master document.

columns.description: Total transaction amount for the source document group.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
